description: This file implements the DatabaseConnection class, providing methods for connecting, disconnecting, executing queries, and retrieving results from a database within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It manages database handles, performs thread-safe query execution, and includes callback functions for processing query results.

classes.name: DatabaseConnection
classes.description: Manages a database connection, allowing for opening, closing, executing queries, and retrieving results with thread safety.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the specified database, opening or creating it as needed.

methods.name: DisConnect
methods.description: Closes the current database connection if open.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes a SQL query on the database.

methods.name: ExecAndGetModified
methods.description: Executes a query and retrieves the number of affected rows.

methods.name: ExecAndGetResults
methods.description: Executes a query and retrieves the result set into a DatabaseTable.

methods.name: DbCallbackOnly
methods.description: Callback function for queries that do not return results.

methods.name: DbCallbackGetResults
methods.description: Callback function for queries that return result sets.
